summary: Freeze Reference page-selector versions and use a four-page v4 default for new tasks while retaining six-page v3 replay for all existing tasks.
decision_refs: The active goal requires local verifiable page selection to reduce unnecessary advanced-model input
The current fixed 15-question task selected six pages for every question, but the independently recorded answer page ranked within the first four for all 15 questions
Changing a global selector without freezing its version would make existing evaluation inputs non-reproducible
approval_evidence: The active user goal explicitly requires CIRP to reduce unnecessary LLM input through lightweight local verifiable page selection while managing versioned tasks and results.
known_limitations: The four-page gate proves expected source-page inclusion for the fixed fixture, not answer correctness or completeness.
Existing evaluations intentionally retain selector v3 and its six-page default; they are not silently upgraded.
The 48,000-byte local selection ceiling remains for audit compatibility, while model evidence is separately serialized under 18,000 bytes.
No advanced-model request or paid benchmark is run by this implementation task.
